newsitem.title: CHINA: Australia, Belgium, Canada consuls to stay in HK.
newsitem.headline: Australia, Belgium, Canada consuls to stay in HK.

text.p: China said on Thursday it had agreed to let the consuls general of Australia, Belgium and Canada stay in Hong Kong after the British colony reverted to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30.

China was in the process of issuing documents to other countries that would allow their consuls general to remain in the territory after the handover, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing.
The process was likely to be completed before July 1, Shen said.
On Tuesday, China said countries that did not have diplomatic relations with Beijing would not be allowed to maintain consulates in Hong Kong after the handover.
